_comment: Tier-2 for linear_elasticity#4 — INVERTED 2026-08-03 on deal.II 9.8.0-pre. The old pitfall claimed 'deal.II 2D ONLY reads QUADS from Gmsh — no triangles. Signal: ExcMessage from grid_in.cc'. False since deal.II 9.3 added simplex support, and this fixture already knew: on 9.8.0-pre it printed 'ERROR: GridIn::read_msh accepted triangles; pitfall claim does not hold in this deal.II version' and failed its own expect_in_output. The fixture now asserts the corrected claim — a triangles-only Gmsh mesh (element type 2) reads into Triangulation<2> and yields triangle cells (n_vertices() == 3). RecombineAll is a preference, not a requirement; the real downstream constraint is that simplex cells need FE_SimplexP + QGaussSimplex and are not supported by MatrixFree.
